name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Boost Your Efficiency with AI Templates
short_description: Template is an AI skill that automates content creation for finance teams. It generates high-quality templates for reports, presentations, and documents. Connects to Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex. Reduces manual work and ensures consistency across financial communications.
author: anthropics

sections.overview:
Template is an AI skill designed to automate content creation for finance teams by generating professional templates for reports, presentations, and documents. The skill integrates with popular AI development tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex to provide seamless workflow integration. By automating template generation, it reduces manual work and ensures consistency across all financial communications. Finance professionals can leverage this skill to accelerate document creation while maintaining standardized formatting and content structure across their organization.
Create personalized marketing emails that resonate with your audience.
Design eye-catching social media posts that drive engagement.
Generate structured blog outlines to streamline your writing process.
Produce consistent branding materials across various platforms.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`npx skills add anthropics/skills`
`git clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a [DOCUMENT_TYPE] template for [COMPANY_NAME]’s finance team to use in [CONTEXT]. Include sections for [SPECIFIC_SECTIONS], ensuring it aligns with [COMPANY_STYLE_GUIDE] and [COMPANY_TONE]. Use [FINANCIAL_FRAMEWORK] as the basis for calculations and assumptions. Format the output for [OUTPUT_FORMAT] (e.g., Word, Google Docs, Markdown).
```
Copy

```
Here’s a **Quarterly Financial Performance Report Template** for Acme Corp’s finance team to use in Q1 2025. The template includes sections for revenue analysis, expense breakdown, cash flow projections, and key performance indicators (KPIs), aligned with Acme’s corporate style guide and professional tone. It uses the **GAAP framework** for calculations and assumptions, and is formatted for Google Docs.
```
